summary: Marrow Quill is the keeper of the lamp on Saltgrave Point, a made-up character in the sample story. [1]

sections.title: Role
sections.content: Marrow has kept the lamp for eleven winters and lights it whenever she is unsure. [1] She hosts Oddment and Tamsin Verrow after the Patient Heron arrives. [2]

citations.quote: Marrow Quill had kept the lamp on Saltgrave Point for eleven winters
she thanked Marrow for the tea in a way that sounded like an apology
